newsitem.title: USA: Furniture Brands files for public offering.
newsitem.headline: Furniture Brands files for public offering.

text.p: Furniture Brands International Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the previously reported public offering of 11 million shares.
The shares were owned by the company's largest stockholder, Apollo Investment Fund LP, and its affiliate, Lion Advisors LP.
Furniture Brands said neither the company nor management will sell any shares in the proposed offering.
The underwriters for the offering are Smith Barney, Credit Suisse First Boston, Dillon, Read & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co, Salomon Brothers and Wheat First Butcher Singer.
